raw.details:
Hack Paradise – Kaushalya 2.0

Welcome to HACK PARADISE, an exciting hackathon organized as part of KAUSHALYA 2.0, the annual technical and cultural festival of Chhattisgarh Swami Vivekanand Technical University (CSVTU), University Teaching Department, Bhilai.

HACK PARADISE is a platform for developers, innovators, programmers, and creative problem-solvers to transform their ideas into practical solutions. It brings together passionate students who are eager to explore technology, collaborate with like-minded individuals, and build innovative projects.

Participants will get an opportunity to demonstrate their technical knowledge, creativity, teamwork, and problem-solving abilities through an intensive 8-hour building sprint.

Event Format

  • Duration: 8 Hours
  • Participants will work on developing innovative solutions during the hackathon.
  • Projects will be evaluated by the judging panel.
  • Participants will have the opportunity to present their solutions and demonstrate their work.

General Guidelines

  1. Participants must complete their registration through the official registration platform.
  2. Teams must adhere to the team formation guidelines announced by the organizers.
  3. All projects must be developed and submitted within the prescribed hackathon duration.
  4. Participants must ensure that their submissions represent their team's work.
  5. Plagiarism or misrepresentation of work may result in disqualification.
  6. Participants must follow the instructions and submission guidelines provided by the organizing committee.
  7. The judges' decision regarding evaluation and results will be final.

Our Sponsor Partners

We are proud to collaborate with:

  • ElevenLabs

  • n8n

  • Fueler

  • InterviewBuddy

  • .xyz Domains

  • CleanShot X

We sincerely thank our sponsor partners for supporting Hack Paradise and helping us provide participants with valuable tools, premium subscriptions, and exciting rewards.

Important Information

Detailed information regarding team size, eligibility, problem statements, technology restrictions, submission format, evaluation criteria, and judging rounds will be communicated by the organizing team.

Get ready to turn your ideas into innovation at HACK PARADISE!
